entities.summary: Cynthia Ann Brewer is an American cartographer, author, and professor of geography at Pennsylvania State University. Brewer's specialty relates to visibility and color theory in cartography. In 2023, she was awarded the International Cartographic Association's highest honor, the Carl Mannerfelt Gold Medal, for her distinguished contribution to the field.
